faqs.question: How is this different from an HR and payroll portal?
faqs.answer: This is the HR system of record — the single place that holds your people data, org structure, leave, and attendance and runs your approval flows. It produces a clean, payroll-ready export of approved leave and hours, and we can connect it directly to a payroll engine, but its job is to keep your HR data accurate and your day-to-day requests moving.

faqs.question: Can we map our own leave policies and approval chains?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure your exact leave types, accrual and carry-over rules, and weekend and public-holiday calendars, then build the approval routing to match your real hierarchy. Because you own the system, those rules can be adjusted as your handbook or labour requirements change.

faqs.question: Will it remind us before visas, IDs, and contracts expire?
faqs.answer: It will. The system tracks passport, visa, resident-card, and contract dates and sends automated WhatsApp and email reminders ahead of each deadline. An HR dashboard escalates anything approaching expiry so nothing lapses unnoticed.

faqs.question: Can our Arabic-speaking staff use it in their own language?
faqs.answer: The entire system is bilingual Arabic and English with full right-to-left support. Each employee and manager can switch to their preferred language, and requests, letters, and notifications follow that choice.

faqs.question: Do we own the system, or is there a per-employee licence?
faqs.answer: You fully own the code, the database, and the documentation — there is no per-seat or per-employee licence to renew, so you can add unlimited staff without your costs changing. Start with a free consultation and a demo preview built around your structure; WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us.
